billing.fineprint: Prices include VAT where it applies. Paddle handles payments as our reseller. Cancel a monthly plan any time: it stays active until the end of the month you paid for. A one-time Vow Plus lasts until 90 days after the wedding, and at least a year.
billing.landingTitle: Free to start, more when you need it
billing.landingText: Every couple plans for free. Vow Plus adds what bigger weddings need, and Vow Pro is for wedding planners.
